claim_boundary: deterministic posture findings only; no secure, compromised, or compliant conclusion

findings.claim_limit: Key contents, validity and authentication activity were not collected.
findings.recommendation: Review ownership and permissions separately before changing SSH access.
findings.title: Authorized-key file metadata fell outside the admitted baseline

findings.claim_limit: File contents and distribution-specific policy were not assessed.
findings.recommendation: Review ownership and permissions before changing them; preserve service-specific exceptions.
findings.title: Critical account or privilege file metadata fell outside the admitted baseline

findings.claim_limit: The supplied posture does not record a confirmed root/loopback evaluation context. This does not prove that root login was used or externally reachable.
findings.recommendation: Review an attributable administrator account, working privilege elevation and recovery access before considering disabling direct root SSH login.
findings.title: SSH configuration permits direct root login in an unconfirmed evaluation context

findings.claim_limit: Sudoers contents and effective direct grants were not assessed.
findings.recommendation: Review affected metadata and validate syntax before making any privilege change.
findings.title: Sudoers drop-in metadata fell outside the admitted baseline

findings.claim_limit: Account names and authentication activity were not collected.
findings.recommendation: Review whether every UID 0 account is required and separately attributable.
findings.title: More than one UID 0 account was observed

findings.claim_limit: A failed unit is not by itself evidence of compromise or business impact.
findings.recommendation: Review each failed unit against the host's intended service inventory.
findings.title: Failed system services were observed

findings.claim_limit: Rule order, upstream controls and external reachability were not tested.
findings.recommendation: Confirm that every inbound service is intended and change the default policy only with a recovery path.
findings.title: Host firewall default inbound policy allows traffic

findings.claim_limit: The marker does not identify the package or guarantee that a reboot resolves every pending update.
findings.recommendation: Schedule a controlled reboot with service and recovery checks.
findings.title: The host reports a pending reboot

findings.claim_limit: The scan used local cached metadata and did not refresh repositories or install packages.
findings.recommendation: Review and schedule the security updates through the host's normal change process.
findings.title: Cached package metadata reports available security updates

findings.claim_limit: The supplied posture does not record a confirmed root/loopback evaluation context. This does not prove weak passwords, exposure, or successful authentication.
findings.recommendation: Review attributable administrator access, working privilege elevation and key-based recovery before considering disabling password authentication.
findings.title: SSH password authentication is enabled in an unconfirmed evaluation context

findings.claim_limit: The declared listener baseline does not independently establish service intent. Process identifiers and external reachability were not collected.
findings.recommendation: Identify the owning service and confirm each endpoint before changing or stopping it.
findings.title: Listening endpoints fell outside the declared listener baseline

findings.claim_limit: The collector did not compare the clock against an independent time authority.
findings.recommendation: Restore approved time synchronization and record the source used.
findings.title: Host clock reported not synchronized

findings.claim_limit: This is a posture observation, not proof that workload isolation is ineffective.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the host's intended mandatory-access-control policy and platform support.
findings.title: No enabled AppArmor or enforcing SELinux state was established
